items.title: Video floats over other apps
items.text: On your phone, leave the app while a video plays and it keeps going in a small floating window over whatever you open next.

items.title: Play and pause that make sense
items.text: The small window now shows play when the video is stopped and pause when it is playing. Tap it to show the buttons, then tap play to carry on. Tap it twice, or press the full screen button, to make it big.

items.title: Move and switch the small windows
items.text: Drag the small window anywhere. With a film and a camera both in the corner, swipe sideways on your phone, or press Left or Right on the remote, to switch between them.
